Your holdings: SOXL (-58.2%) and SPAL (-40.12%) need immediate attention. Both are leveraged ETFs with significant losses and decay risk, amplified by your margin trading. QQQ, SMH, and QQQI are also flagged for trimming.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield for any further upward movement. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs closely for continued decay.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your highly volatile, leveraged positions and be mindful of rising interest rates impacting your tech concentration.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL due to its SELL status, -58.2% loss, and leveraged decay risk, especially on margin.
Review SPAL given its NEW status, -40.12% loss, and leveraged decay risk.
